stem: Senator Lodge made this statement in opposition to —

options.label: F
options.text: U.S. membership in the League of Nations

options.label: G
options.text: the funding of a massive buildup of the U.S. Navy

options.label: H
options.text: a relaxation of U.S. citizenship requirements

options.label: J
options.text: U.S. entry into the Spanish-American War

visual_elements: The United States is the world’s best hope, but . . . if you tangle her in the intrigues of Europe, you will destroy her power for good, and endanger her very existence. . . . — Senator Henry Cabot Lodge
